Overview

The hidden cost of Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Education & Research is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on SIS & registries, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. Education & Research punishes generic deployments. learning analytics moves faster than batch cycles, GDPR / privacy regimes demands evidence chains most tools cannot produce, and the estate is heterogeneous — which is why every engagement starts with the seams named above rather than a platform-first rollout.
